hook.name: ForestHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects 1% of each swap's output as "sap" via afterSwapReturnsDelta and distributes it to registered FOREST token holders in a tier-weighted reward pool. Holders earn proportional to their tier (Seedling to Wolf, weights 1–5) based on FOREST balance. Also custodies the launch LP NFT with an owner-callable burn function.
